responsibility: Implements C++ helper logic shared by the 32-bit Arm and AArch64 back ends for target-specific RTL analysis and option support that does not belong in machine-description files. The file provides recognizers for characteristic RTL shapes such as shift forms and REV16 idioms, memory-model predicates used by atomic and barrier expansion, dependency checks used by scheduling and accumulator forwarding heuristics, shared branch-protection and architecture-option validation helpers, and the TARGET_MD_ASM_ADJUST worker that rewrites Arm inline-asm flag outputs into explicit condition-code register handling.
